name: Lorentz National Park
description: Lorentz National Park spans the southwest of Indonesian New Guinea and is the largest protected area in South-East Asia. In one unbroken sweep, it runs from equatorial glaciers on Puncak Jaya, the tallest peak between the Himalayas and the Andes, down through rainforest and swamps to mangroves and the sea. Much of it remains unexplored, and it likely hides species still unknown to science.
